description: Start a competitive-intelligence brief for one company. Returns at once with a brief_id; generation takes 3 to 6 minutes. Then call get_brief(brief_id) after poll_after_seconds. Cost: one credit is held now and spent only if the brief is ready with at least one item. An empty or failed brief costs nothing. Pass the same idempotency_key to retry safely: it returns the original brief instead of starting a second one. Needs OAuth sign-in or an API key. A client with OAuth sign-in asks the user to sign in the first time; a new account gets 1 free brief credit, once per email address. For briefs on a schedule, the user can also subscribe at https://angle.app.infxl.com.

domain.description: The company's own website: a domain such as acme.com, or a URL on it. Not a LinkedIn or directory page.

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Reusing the same key with the same parameters returns the original brief and spends nothing new, for 24 hours.

lookback_days.description: Days of news to cover, 1 to 7. Defaults to 7. The search reaches 2 days further back, because news is often published a day or more after the event; the brief states the exact date range it covers.

name: request_brief

credits_remaining.description: Credits available after this request: the balance minus credits held by briefs in progress.

duplicate.description: True when this returned an earlier request instead of starting a new brief.

poll_after_seconds.description: Seconds to wait before calling get_brief. 0 when the brief is already settled.

title: Request brief
